title: AgentRQ catalog
description: Every component and function of the A2UI v1.0 basic catalog, and the components below. A surface whose createSurface names this catalogId may use both.

Chart.description: A chart drawn as the AgentRQ analytics pages draw theirs.

variant.description: line: a value over time; bar: values side by side; heatmap: a value per day (labels YYYY-MM-DD) or per hour (labels YYYY-MM-DD HH:00).

label.description: What the values count, shown beside each one, such as Tasks.

data.description: The points, in order: a list, or a binding to one in the data model.

color.description: tasks (the default) or messages, the analytics tones, or a #rrggbb colour used as given in both themes.
